content: Qasseka ta ajjuutan wadha wodoro ba kushen oykkidayssa be7adis.
Tanikka iza, «Ne awa bay?» ga oychchadis. Izi qasse, «Yerusalaame adussateththaynne aakoteththay aappun wadhakko wadhdha beyana bays» gides.
He tanara haasayza kiitanchchay bides. Hara kiitanchchayka izara gaagganaas yides.
Histtidi izas, «Woxxa baada hessa naateththa addezas, ‹Yerusalaamey izin diza asa daroteththafenne mehe daroteththafe dendoyssan katamaa yuushon gimbe dirsa koshshenna.
Tani tarkka izis tama dirsa gidana; izi giddon tani izis bonchcho gidana› gees gaada yoota» gides.
GODAY ba deraa, «Ta kase inttena oyddu bagga laalladis; ha7i gidikko pudeha baggafe baqati kezite; haa yiite.
Hanne Xiyoone haa ya; Baabiloone macca naytara de7izaare istta giddofe baqata.
Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY: ba bonchcho qonccisana mala ba asaa bonqqidayta kawoteththaako tana kiittides; inttena bochchizay taas ayfe ciro bochchiza mala.
Hekko tani ta kushe istta bolla denththana; istta aylleti istta bonqqana; hessafe guye Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY tana kiittidayssa intte erana.
«Hanne Xiyoone nayee ane ilila; ufayetta; tani yaada ne giddon daana» gees GODAY.
He gallas daro kawoteththati GODAAKKO shiiqidi iza dere gidana; izikka ne giddon de7ana; Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY tana neekko kiittidayssa nekka erana.
GODAY geeshsha biittayn Yuhuda baas buzo histti laattana; Yerusalaamekka zaari doorana.
GODAY geesh gidida basozappe dendida gishshas asho may7ida ubbay iza sinththan co7u go.
